title: Seestadt Aspern, Vienna and Graz connect housing with local services
summary: One development programme and two municipal places connect housing access and renewal with education, water and energy systems. Eligibility reaches 87 projects and 58 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Fifteen official German HTML records or scoped body segments inspected November 22. Occupancy, allocation, renovation, water commissioning and municipal-group energy retain separate meanings.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
